search_design.restatement_exclusion_not_applicable_rea: low_volatility is a price-only signal with no fundamental restatement dependency, so the fundamental restatement-ambiguity exclusion does not apply to signal scoring

decision.plain_result: Large-cap low_volatility failed at least one frozen statistical-alpha-clue gate, so it is falsified under this frozen single-primary-cell design.
decision.next_action: If the primary cell fails, do not rescue it with CSI1000, 252d, non-neutral, cap-weighted, diagnostic factors, an alternative trailing window, idiosyncratic volatility, threshold, horizon, benchmark, or universe changes without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger. A passing clue or tradeable candidate is research-only until forward-live ship-gate evidence exists.

limitations: This summary is research-only and reads already-materialized local raw data only.

low_volatility is externally literature-motivated rather than in-sample-diagnostic-derived (cleaner provenance than cash_conversion), but it is still a single 2018-2025 in-sample period test and the vs-CSI300 evidence is single-sample; even a passing result is research-only.
It was selected at the program level after three prior spent singletons, so the new singleton ledger bounds but does not eliminate program-level multiple testing.
Statistical power is limited: 504d holds plus the trailing 252d volatility window bound cohorts at both ends, so the HAC t-stat rests on a short effective sample.
The relative-NAV drawdown gate only governs the tradeable-candidate label, not the statistical-alpha-clue verdict.
The unchanged project ship gate still requires at least 12 months of forward-live evidence.
No provider call, DataHub work, broker access, automatic order execution, or production storage is authorized.
